sentences.en: Japanese love to soak in a hot tub before bed.
sentences.zh: 日本人喜欢在睡前泡个热水澡。

sentences.en: The tub ran over while she was on the phone.
sentences.zh: 她在打电话的时候浴缸里的水溢出来了。

sentences.en: He held her down in the tub until she drowned.
sentences.zh: 他把她按在浴缸里直到她溺死。

senses.zh: 洗盆浴；（衣服等）被放在桶里洗
